# WIDA jiangly 08B strict predecessor

Exact upstream bytes from hh2048/XCPC tree cfdb12db6792eb2303798541fb5c760ed2bc618b, `03 - jiangly模板收集/04 - 数据结构/08B - 其他平衡树.cpp`, blob 9a3d889134948b382b54dea265fe4a2bad98ccdd.

Original attribution: jiangly, https://codeforces.com/contest/1864/submission/220558951, 2023-08-26. Upstream GPL-3.0 provenance is retained; the fixture is not relicensed as original MIT library code.

The source has no main. It inserts one count and queries the greatest position strictly below x in a pointwise nonnegative version difference. Full original problem identity/protocol remains unverified; the Codeforces submission page was blocked by a security challenge. Runtime tests keep the original functions unchanged and compare against independent array histograms, including valid non-ancestor version pairs.
